subject: Demo request: Dedicated capacity throughput & latency fit call
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@zenstream.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for ZenStream throughput validation

Hi Marcus,

I signed up via your self-serve flow earlier today (we're evaluating Dedicated for a production rollout) and wanted to follow up with a few details so we can get a targeted walkthrough. We're ZenStream — realtime transcription + enrichment at scale. High level: 
- Peak traffic ~7,000 requests/minute (approx 117 rps), spiky bursts up to ~250 rps for short windows.
- Avg response ~45 tokens; sometimes up to 120 tokens for long transcripts.
- Latency SLO: 95th <= 350ms for short responses; tail matters.

I've attached a small sample of our traffic patterns and a CSV with request timestamps so you can see burstiness. Can Ben or someone from your team run a quick intake to confirm feasibility and suggest an appropriate Dedicated config (GPU type, instance count, batching/kv cache guidance)? We're in PST.

Availability: Tue/Thu 10am–2pm PT or Fri morning.

Attachement: zenstream_traffic_sample.csv (3kb)

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Amy Chen
Head of AI
ZenStream
amy@zenstream.io
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@zenstream.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for ZenStream throughput validation

Hi Amy — great to meet you and thanks for the data. I'm Ben (SDR) — I'll coordinate the intake and loop in Laura (solutions) for a short technical fit call. A couple quick clarifying Qs so Laura can size the right config before the demo: 

- Is peak QPS measured as concurrent inference requests or after your front-end batching?
- Typical prompt/response token split (prompt tokens vs response tokens)?
- Any on-prem/VPC networking constraints we should know about for the test?

Proposed 30-minute slots (PT):
- Wed 2028-10-03 09:00–09:30 PT
- Wed 2028-10-03 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu 2028-10-04 11:00–11:30 PT

If none of those work we can do Fri morning as you suggested. We'll prepare a short perf checklist and suggested Dedicated configs (GPU types + expected QPS per node, batching knobs). Laura — can you confirm if we should run a short load sketch during the call?

Thanks,

—Ben
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Amy Chen <amy@zenstream.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for ZenStream throughput validation

Hi Ben — 10:00–10:30 PT on Wed (2028-10-03) works for us. Answers inline: 

> Is peak QPS measured as concurrent inference requests or after your front-end batching?

It's measured at the edge before our batching aggregation layer — we batch client events into 1–2 request groups, but bursts still translate into high ingress. Please assume minimal batching for the intake.

> Typical prompt/response token split?

Prompts ~30–60 tokens; responses 35–120 tokens depending on transcript length.

> Any on-prem/VPC networking constraints?

We're cloud-first for inference (GCP), but for pilot we'll route traffic through a staging VPC. I uploaded the full sample CSV and a short readme to this Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bZenStreamTraffic — the file in the mailbox is the truncated sample.

I'll invite our infra PM (ops@zenstream.io) to the call if that's helpful. See you Wed 10/03 10:00 PT.

—Amy
Amy Chen
Head of AI, ZenStream
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@zenstream.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for ZenStream throughput validation

Hi Amy — thanks for jumping on Wed at 10:00 PT. I've put a 30-min hold on the calendar and will send the invite with a Zoom link + a short pre-call checklist. Quick notes for the call so we can be efficient: 

Agenda (30 min):
1) 5m intros & scope (what traffic windows to prioritize)
2) 10m perf sketch: expected QPS, token lengths, simulated load approach
3) 10m recommended Dedicated configs + quantization/ batching guidance (expected QPS per node, GPU family options)
4) Action items and pilot next steps (data sharing, test harness)

Pre-call ask: please share the Drive folder access to laura_bennett@redwood.com and confirm a contact who can provide short-term staging credentials (we'll only need a temporary endpoint/IP allowlist). We'll attempt a light load sketch during the call (no production traffic) — is ops@zenstream.io able to provide a staging endpoint?

Calendar: 'ZenStream — Dedicated capacity fit call' 2028-10-03 10:00–10:30 PT (Zoom). Invite: attachment ics stub (ZenStream_fitcall_invite.ics).

Looking forward — will include a short perf-run playbook in the invite.

Best,
